_comment: IteratedUltimatumGame locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is; do not translate the action tokens [Offer: $X] / [Accept] / [Reject]. Keep the '$' currency symbol and all numbers as-is.

_slots.{pool}: Amount of money available each round (a number)
_slots.{keep}: The amount the proposer keeps (a number)
_slots.{proposer_gain}: Money the proposer gained this round (a number)
_slots.{responder_gain}: Money the responder gained this round (a number)
_slots.{total}: Each player's tied final total (a number)

player_prompt.intro:
U mosebetši {player_id}, u tšoantšetse {num_rounds} makhopho a Iterated Ultimatum Game.
U na le $ {pool} ho arolelana mokhophong o jang lipakeng tsa hao le mosebetši {other_id}.

Proposer:
  - Etsa ofele: [Offer: $X] (0 <= X <= pool)
  - Ha e amohelwe → U fumana $ (pool - X), mosebetši e mong fumana $X
  - Ha e hanwe → Bobeli ba fumana $0
  - Mohlala: [Offer: $3]  kapa  'Ke nahana hore sena se lokile. [Offer: $5]'

Responder:
  - Tšoantšetsa ofele ka [Accept] kapa [Reject]
  - Mohlala: 'Hona kea utloahala. [Accept]'
            'Hona ha le lokile. [Reject]'

round.begins:
--- Raundi {round_number} qala! ---
Tshameki {proposer_id} ke mosehetsi, Tshameki {responder_id} ke moretsi.
round.offer: Dibeto {round_number}: Motsamaisi {proposer_id} a kenya ${offer} ho Motsamaisi {responder_id} (a tsamaya le ${keep}).
round.accepted: Motsamaisi {responder_id} a amohetse! Dibeto {round_number} tse dishes: Motsamaisi {proposer_id} +${proposer_gain}, Motsamaisi {responder_id} +${responder_gain}. Dibeto tse ncha: Motsamaisi 0: ${total_0}, Motsamaisi 1: ${total_1}.
round.rejected: Motsamaisi {responder_id} a tswafatsa selemo! Dibeto {round_number} tse dishes: Ba bangwe ba na +$0. Dibeto di tswele pele: Motsamaisi 0: ${total_0}, Motsamaisi 1: ${total_1}.

invalid_move.no_offer_format: Mofani oa thepa o tlameha ho etsa tlhahiso a sebelisa sebopeho sa [Offer: $X].
invalid_move.bad_integer: Chelete e fanoeng e tlameha ho ba palo ea sebele.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Nyehelo e tlameha ho ba pakeng tsa $0 le ${pool}.
invalid_move.no_current_offer: Ha ho na tlhahiso ea hona joale eo u ka e arabelang.
invalid_move.accept_or_reject: Motsamaisi o tlameha ho [Accept] kapa [Reject] selemo.

outcome.win: Motsamaisi {winner} o ile a fenya le ${winner_total} e kgahlelisiwa le Motsamaisi {loser} ${loser_total}.
outcome.draw: Bapala ka bobeli ba qetile ka ${total} kakaretso.
